## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the trigger, intended behavior and bounded scope. Link the issue/story if available.

## Verification

List actual checks/results and remaining blockers. Distinguish fixture, VM, physical-hardware and live-provider evidence.

- [ ] Relevant documentation and screenshots are updated.
- [ ] Private credentials, runtime state and personal identifiers are excluded.
- [ ] MIT attribution and third-party notices are preserved.
- [ ] For UI changes: preview URL, source revision, start/stop steps and limitations are recorded (or explain why unavailable).
- [ ] The change stays within the reviewed scope; no unapproved paid routing, permission changes, sends or deployment.

Passing CI is not approval to merge, publish, deploy or accept unfinished artifacts.
